candidates.name: completion-versus-signing lifecycle (uncertainty resolution)
candidates.jev_task: select the verbatim stated expected-close/outside date and completion date from regex-enumerated date spans; code does the calendar arithmetic
candidates.single_economic_primary: acute event uncertainty resolves from signing to completion, so implied vol should fall more than realized movement
candidates.structure_and_why: covered_call or cash_secured_put; these are the only two of the five that structurally express a vol-crush (short premium), while long_call and protective put are hurt by it and the collar is roughly neutral
candidates.main_falsifier_confound: completion is pre-announced with a known expected date, so the crush may be priced; this anticipation is a falsifier to test, not proof of a zero edge; effect diluted by acquirer/target mix and by anticipation
candidates.role_independence_note: the selling-premium (covered_call / cash_secured_put) hypothesis is a volatility statement, not a sign-of-return statement, so no acquirer/target role and no direction is required
candidates.differs_from_failed: exact strategic-transaction lifecycle tags instead of the Item 1.01 keyword proxy (Route F); its endpoint duplicates the already-graded Route 2 calibration, which is a limited-novelty observation and not an empirical rejection
candidates.jev_date_measurement_status: later verbatim JEV date-span measurement is useful but unvalidated; incremental measurement utility is not yet demonstrated

candidates.name: literal cash consideration versus option strike (deal-spread convergence)
candidates.jev_task: select the verbatim cash consideration per share (USD value span) and expected close date; code computes consideration minus parity spot and compares to strikes/expiry (deterministic arithmetic, no direction/materiality label)
candidates.single_economic_primary: an all-cash deal pins the target stock to the cash price at completion; long_call struck below the stated cash consideration is a defined convergence bet
candidates.structure_and_why: long_call; its payoff is bounded by cash minus strike on completion and its direction is the literal convergence, with no sentiment or role label
candidates.main_falsifier_confound: in TOP_100 the filer is almost always the acquirer, so the consideration relates to the target, not the filer; target-side events are only partly excluded by the static 2026 snapshot (pre-snapshot acquired/delisted cases; unresolved historical target agreements remain possible and their count is UNKNOWN); selecting spot-below-cash to recover the target role is itself a role verdict
candidates.known_counts: UNKNOWN; only an UNVERIFIED Item 1.01 keyword reconnaissance (110 filings / 43 issuers) exists in RESEARCH_NEXT_DIRECTION.md Route F, which is not this tag count and is not used as one
candidates.differs_from_failed: exact tags plus a literal cash-amount extraction versus Route F's acquirer-announcement keyword proxy; fails on structural role/survivorship, not on a count

candidates.name: contractual future date versus option expiry (timing realism)
candidates.jev_task: select the verbatim maturity/term/expiration date; code compares it to the 3-6m option expiry
candidates.single_economic_primary: none: it measures whether the contractual event resolves before or after expiry, which is entry-lag/coverage realism, not a sign or magnitude
candidates.structure_and_why: no one of the five structures is implicated; no directional channel exists
candidates.main_falsifier_confound: no payoff channel; dates frequently absent from the summary; debt_issuance/credit_facility re-imports the excluded credit respec
candidates.differs_from_failed: structurally the same class as LITERAL_MEASUREMENT_FEASIBILITY Route B (release delay, graded 2/1/2/2/2 and not selected), so it is not new
